meaning_en: {entity_type} {key} is written only by the harness, inside another human confirm — it cannot be set or confirmed by itself
meaning_zh: {entity_type} {key} 只由系统在本人确认其他决定时一并写入，不能单独设置或确认

meaning_en: --source is required: who said it and when (convention: <who>_<status>_<YYYY-MM-DD>)
meaning_zh: 需要写明来源：谁说的、什么时候说的（格式：<谁>_<状态>_<年-月-日>）
指定值确认时只能针对一个对象

meaning_en: {entity_id}: its pending value was withdrawn — nothing to confirm (a new set proposes again; a human may confirm a value of their own)
meaning_zh: {entity_id}：待确认的值已撤回，没有可确认的内容（重新设置即可再次提议；本人也可以直接确认自己给出的值）

meaning_en: Nothing confirmed: {refused} of {total} ids cannot be — {reasons}
meaning_zh: 一项都没有确认：{total} 个对象中有 {refused} 个不能确认——{reasons}

meaning_en: {market} {entity_type} {key}: the decision changed while the confirm waited for its answer — nothing was written; run it again to see the current value
meaning_zh: {market} {entity_type} {key}：等待确认期间这项决定有了变化，未写入任何内容；请重新运行查看最新的值

meaning_en: Nothing withdrawn: no pending {market} {entity_type} {key} for {entity_ids} ({refused} of {total} ids) — only a value awaiting a confirm can be withdrawn
meaning_zh: 一项都没有撤回：{entity_ids} 没有待确认的 {market} {entity_type} {key}（{total} 个中有 {refused} 个）；只能撤回等待确认的值
